csv_project_name: Surveying Services for Frederick Douglass Tunnel
csv_scope_of_work: Amtrak intends to accept Letters of Interest (LOI) for this upcoming solicitation. Responses shall include qualification information that is requested/stated below. Amtrak, at its sole discretion and without discussion, will determine which firms are to be shortlisted for the impending Request for Proposal for Tunnel Surveying Services. The existing Baltimore & Potomac (B&P) Tunnel, located in West Baltimore, is owned by Amtrak and serves approximately 150 trains per day. It is used by Amtrak (both Acela and Regional services), Maryland Area Rail Commuter (MARC) passenger trains, and Norfolk Southern Railway (NS) freight trains. The tunnel has limitations that inhibit reliability, speed, and service growth and require continuing repairs to facilitate service levels. The tunnel footprint is currently too small to permit the addition of modern fire and life safety systems. Amtrak is constructing a new deep bore tunnel, replacing the West Baltimore MARC Station and making other at-grade improvements along a 10-mile section of its Northeast Corridor in Baltimore, Maryland. This new tunnel, Frederick Douglass Tunnel (FDT), and associated improvements will replace the existing Baltimore & Potomac Tunnel, reduce travel time and improve overall system reliability. The Contractor shall provide tunnel surveyor services, rendered by the Independent Tunnel Construction Verification Surveyor (ITCVS), who will report directly to Amtrak, Project Delivery Partner (DP) and/or Architectural Engineer (A/E). Services shall include confirming survey control points and baselines as necessary to control the alignment (vertical and horizontal) and all parts of the Services within the specified tolerances, and documentation of the results. The ITCVS shall also review the surveying program, developed and implemented by the Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR). The Designer of Record (DoR) has provided survey control network for the project. The survey control network requires verification by the ITCVS to confirm its adequacy for a large tunnel project. If the control network is determined to be inadequate, the ITCVS shall identify the source of any discrepancy and advise on adjustments needed to resolve all deficiencies.
